articles.title: Hyperliquid, Pump.fun account for nearly 90% of record $638M crypto buybacks: FT
articles.snippet: Crypto projects spent a record $638 million on token buybacks so far in 2026, as more protocols are turning their revenue into buybacks to return more value to token holders.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Bitcoin pumps, Wall Street does the paperwork
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s $80,000 rebound lifts crypto stocks as Circle, Strategy and Solana show how capital markets, stablecoins and onchain growth are driving crypto’s recovery.
